title: WBCodeFYName step configuration
description: Unsecure configuration for both WBCodeFYName steps (Create and Update): the logical names of the project's table and columns. The plug-in enforces the same rules at runtime (StepConfig.cs) and the tests keep the two in step.

targetTable.description: The table the steps are registered on.

nameColumn.description: The text primary name column that receives WBCodeFY.

wbCodeLookup.description: The lookup column on the target table that references the WBCode.

wbCodeValueColumn.description: The text column on the WBCode's table that holds the WBCode, e.g. 00224570.

fyLookup.description: The lookup column on the target table that references the FY.

fyValueColumn.description: The text column on the FY's table that holds the FY, e.g. FY26.
